title: Ujwalam studio theme pack (D293; schema v2 with components, D336)
description: A whole-UI theme as data: colours, type, geometry, depth (shadow, glow, extrusion per element class), motion, background and icon weight. Fonts are family names: Windows fonts, or the bundled open-licence families in data/fonts (Inter, Barlow, Exo 2; SIL OFL 1.1, D344). Microsoft font files are never bundled. Add your own file beside the built-in ones; the id must match the file name. Schema v2 (D336) adds optional parts: the components block (enumerated variants only), depth highlight / inset / rim, caps flags and a type scale, the blueprint and columns patterns and a backdrop frame. They are read only while the feature flag theme-components is on; a pack without them looks exactly as before.

dark.description: true for a dark palette (sets the Qt palette base)

onAccent.description: text and icons on accent and danger fills

warn.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): a warning hue; left out, the studio uses danger

info.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): an information hue; left out, accent

accent.description: fill of primary buttons and round primary controls

panel.description: optional: fill of cards, group boxes and the task panel (flat panel colour when absent or in High performance)

control.description: optional: fill of plain buttons (flat field colour when absent or in High performance)

letterSpacing.description: pixels added between letters (QFont absolute spacing)

hinting.description: optional (D376): glyph hinting. full keeps stems on the pixel grid (ClearType GDI-classic) at every display scale; default lets Qt choose

display.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): a display family for large titles (a serif for vapor and book titles). Bundled open families or Windows families only; read by later slices

mono.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): a monospace family for the pixel button and the tooltip label. Read by later slices

headingCaps.description: optional (v2): section titles and headings in capitals

scale.description: optional (v2): type scale in points. h1 section titles, h2 toast titles and look names, subtitle group titles, body window text, caption captions, button button labels

controlPadding.description: optional: padding inside buttons in px (default 5 x 12)

depth.description: Per element class. An empty object means no effect. Shadows belong on floating things, glow on primary or active things, extrusion on round controls and primary buttons.

hoverLift.description: pixels a button with depth rises on hover

spring.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): the shared exact spring (USpring.qml); a part left out keeps 300 / 30 / 1

enterMs.description: optional (RareUI slice 0): longest entrance, ms; the project rule is under 600

exitMs.description: optional (RareUI slice 0): longest exit, ms; the project rule is under 400

loopMs.description: optional (RareUI slice 0): period of continuous decoration (shimmer, sweep); 0 = off. Never runs while on air (Theme.fx)

system.description: optional (D389): the design system the Qt Quick studio's components read (Theme.sp, ty, elev, ring, st, mo). Any part left out keeps the built-in default.

type.description: type scale in px (bundled families only); displayFamily is the heading family

elevation.description: real layered soft shadows per level e0 (flat) to e4 (dialog): a tight key shadow and a wide ambient one

ring.description: keyboard focus ring: width and offset in px, alpha of the accent

state.description: strength (0..1) of the hover and pressed overlays, and the opacity of a disabled control

motion.description: longest entrance and exit in ms (the project rule: under 600 and under 400)

kind.description: gradient uses gradients.window; pattern draws on top of it. Drawn by Qt: no image files.

pattern.description: blueprint (v2): a fine grid with a stronger line every 5 cells; columns (v2): faint layout columns. With the flag theme-components off, blueprint draws as grid and columns as none.

animated.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): a moving backdrop drawn by the studio; none when left out. Never on while on air, in High performance or behind the preview

frame.description: optional (v2): a thin frame just inside each window in the pattern colour; ticks adds registration marks at the corners and edge middles

components.description: Optional (v2, D336): the component language as enumerated variants, data only. Read only while the feature flag theme-components is on. A key left out keeps the base look of that component.

style.description: glass, premium, pixel and liquid (RareUI slice 0, D384): accepted, drawn by later slices. Fill and edge of buttons and round controls; raised (D376): soft raised pills painted from the surface block, the warm face when checked

secondary.description: plain (not primary) buttons; left out: they follow style

tabs.description: slide, avatar and dock (RareUI, D384): drawn by the Qt Quick studio in slice 2 (Settings page list, theme picker, top bar dock)

input.description: soft (D376): a sunken well in the surface block's well colours

switch.description: the painted on/off switch; labelled (ON / OFF in the track) is the base look; knob (D376): a raised round knob in a sunken track that glows warm when on

valueBubble.description: the value in a bubble above the handle while it is dragged

card.description: tilt and shatter (RareUI slice 0, D384): accepted, drawn by later slices, never while on air. soft (D376): raised plates painted from the surface block (needs it)

density.description: layout spacing: compact x0.75, normal x1, airy x1.25 of the built-in spacing

tooltip.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): accepted, drawn by a later slice

toast.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): notification style, accepted and drawn by a later slice

spinner.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): the busy spinner

text.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): text effects on chosen headings only; never while on air

clips.description: optional (RareUI slice 0, D384): how My clips lists clips

componentsAlways.description: optional (D376): the components block and the other v2 parts apply whether the flag theme-components is on or not. For a pack whose look depends on them (Soft): choosing the theme is the opt-in.

surface.description: Optional (D376, with components.card soft): raised plates painted by the studio from cached pictures (no per-widget effect): a face gradient with a light top edge and a darker bottom edge, a wide soft shadow, a tight contact shadow and a light halo up-left; sunken wells; and the warm glow of active controls. Read with the other v2 parts.

glowInk.description: text and marks on a warm face

margin.description: room around a card for its shadow, in px

stroke.description: line weight on the 24 x 24 icon grid

when.description: inset only: always (a sunken well) or only while pressed

colorRef.description: hex, a colour token, or auto (accent, danger while the control is active)

angle.description: 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom

when.description: always only on primary or floating elements; active = live, recording or checked

depth.description: pixels of 3D edge under the element

color2.description: far end of the edge: a bevel or chrome gradient

highlight.description: optional (v2): a second, light shadow with its own offset (neumorphic plates: light up-left, shadow down-right)

inset.description: optional (v2): an inner shadow inside the face: a sunken well, or with when = pressed only while pressed

rim.description: optional (v2): a gradient edge on the face, top colour to bottom colour (metal rims, brass bezels); innerGlow adds a glowing edge just inside it
